scope: Explicit Python development-profile and command-prefix launch factories, native CLI argument diagnostics and bounded native startup. Original incomplete agent workflow is retained separately.

implemented.native_argument_diagnostics: Unsupported world/serve option and missing profile path are distinct.

original_fresh_agent_attempt.model_identity_scope: Explicit CLI selection; event format does not identify actual model.
original_fresh_agent_attempt.actual_cause: One unsupported --profiles flag, not duplicate profile arguments. The original agent self-diagnosis is retained without adopting it.
original_fresh_agent_attempt.native_stdout_kind: CLI error envelope, not a JSON-RPC terminal response
original_fresh_agent_attempt.usage_scope: Original CLI-reported cumulative usage; no monetary cost or comparative efficiency estimate.

factory_tests.scope: Fake factory/transport tests: literal defaults, text/path-like profiles, argument rejection, prefix copying, forwarding and unchanged error propagation. These are not native execution evidence.

windows.core_retention: Independent gzip level1, mtime0; complete streamed decompression verifies original bytes and SHA-256.

retained_qualification_failures.cause: Missing output parent directory; Python failed before creating the Job or launching a native engine.
retained_qualification_failures.later_check: Separate fresh output and admission, same immutable worker, after explicit parent preparation.

boundaries: The original failed fresh workflow is not repaired, resumed or regraded. Startup checks use empty development-profile catalogs, not character games or compilation.
Native queries, compiler execution, provider completion and independently verified gameplay remain separate scopes.
No game save/continuation, export, renderer, GUI, physical input, audio listening, representative performance, clean-machine installation or whole Alpha release is qualified here.
Explicit prefixes establish no sandbox or descendant ownership. Windows Job closure is observed; global process absence is not claimed.

reproduce.cli_regression: Run the existing cli_contract CTest against the matching configured native build.
reproduce.profile_startup: Create a profile JSON with format poima.development-profiles, version 1 and profiles []; use both documented factories with development_profiles, discover the world and development.profiles, and retain bounded raw traces.
